_comment: Claude Code adapter: install to .claude/settings.json (practice `session-bootstrap`). Wires the SessionStart hook (which execs tools/bootstrap.sh), a PreToolUse hook that surfaces the path-triggered loading channel's matched practice Rules before an Edit/Write/NotebookEdit proceeds, TWO Stop hooks (stop-git-check.sh blocks ending a turn with uncommitted/untracked/unpushed work; stop-reply-check.sh prints the reply gate's reminders, blocks a reply that broke a declared requirement, and runs close detection -- split 2026-09-23 so a repo objecting to one can keep the other, see INSTALL.md's decision table), and allowlists the routine safe commands sessions run constantly, so work doesn't stall on permission prompts. Add your repo's own audit/build commands. The Precedent loader commands are listed BOTH bare and with arguments: Claude Code matches `Bash(cmd *)` against an invocation that actually has arguments, so a bare `python3 tools/doc_lint.py` -- the exact form the merge runbook and AGENTS.md's own light check tell every session to run -- prompted on every single run until both forms were listed. ALSO WIRED, since 2026-09-06: freshness-guard.sh three times (a SessionStart pass that fetches and fast-forwards when that is provably lossless, a UserPromptSubmit re-check, and a PreToolUse gate that refuses the session's first tool call on a checkout it cannot vouch for) -- replace the base branch on ALL THREE, and commit-identity.sh, which resolves whoever is running the session and installs a pre-commit hook refusing a commit authored by the container's own bot account. REPLACE THE BASE BRANCH ARGUMENT (`main` below) with this repo's real base branch -- it is passed explicitly because asking git for the default branch gets it wrong in at least one real repo. The PreToolUse matcher for the guard includes Bash on purpose: an agent editing files through cat/sed/python3 never touches Edit or Write at all. commit-identity-once.sh runs commit-identity.sh again at the first tool call, once per session, for a session rooted one directory above the repo that ran none of these SessionStart hooks. WHICH HOOKS A REPO GETS is declared in tools/precedent_vendor_engine.py's HOOK_WIRING, per kind; a refresh ADDS a missing entry from that list to an installed repo's settings.json (never edits or removes one), so a hook added upstream reaches every repo. To opt out of one, declare it in precedent.json's declined_adapters with the reason. The env block's TZ is a stated DEFAULT for people who have declared no timezone anywhere; a person whose individual practice source declares one gets that instead, enforced by the pre-commit hook.
